Presenting the full video song "Tumhare Siva" from the Bollywood movie 'Tum Bin... Love Will Find A Way' featuring Himanshu Malik, Sandali Sinha. The song is sung by Anuradha Paudwal, Udit Narayan, and the music is composed by Nikhil, Vinay. The lyrics are written by Faiz Anwar.
